summary: Backend regression for Ross House Rentals: (A) admin 2FA bypass fix, (B) Newsletter Pro CRUD + scheduling + AI bilingual, (C) Chat messages/read/AI toggle/admin send, (D) Consent forms PDF generation. All 23 tests PASS (100%). Ran against real backend http://localhost:8002 with prod Mongo (taxportal). Admin 2FA temporarily disabled for token acquisition and restored to enabled=True at teardown; admin lockout reset; all TEST_iter31 campaigns deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: consent_forms_router.py uses inconsistent field names: /background-check and /income-verification take 'applicant_name', while /photo-video and /ach-authorization take 'tenant_name'. Consider standardising to a single field or accepting both aliases to reduce client-side branching (mobile client already handles both, but is a small UX/DX smell).
admin_2fa_router._verify_password swallows all bcrypt exceptions and returns False silently — fine for prod but hides malformed hash bugs; consider logging at warning level once per unique user_id.

newsletter_pro_router.create_campaign_pro accepts either 'subject' or 'subject_es' but the DB doc key is 'subject' only; the update endpoint maps both 'subject' and 'subject_es' onto the same db field. This is a latent aliasing quirk — documented in code but easy to break if a future refactor stores subject_es separately.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 test newsletter campaigns during CRUD tests (draft, scheduled, recurring, duplicate). All deleted in teardown; verified 0 leftover TEST_iter31 rows in newsletter_campaigns.
